question: Limba Ram is associated with which sport?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Archery.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **LIMBA RAM**

 
 
• Limba Ram is an eminent figure in** the sport of archery**, known for his exceptional skill and contributions.
 
• He has represented India in multiple international competitions, including the Olympics, bringing fame to the country through his performances.
 
• Limba Ram has set and broken several national and international records during his career in archery.
 
• His dedication to archery has inspired many young athletes in India to pursue the sport professionally.
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Athletics
 Athletics encompasses a range of track and field events, including running, jumping, and throwing competitions.
 
 

 2) Badminton
 Badminton is a racquet sport played using racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net, popular worldwide and in India.
 
 

 3) Polo
 Polo is a team sport played on horseback where players aim to score goals against an opposing team by hitting a small ball using a long-handled mallet.
